Short answers:
- EU transfers: we can execute using the latest EU SCCs (2021) as the primary mechanism. We will include standard SCCs in the DPA execution packet.
- UK transfers: we accept the UK IDTA (UK Addendum) in combination with the SCCs where relevant — we will include the signed UK Addendum as part of the DPA packet.

What we'll send you by EOD tomorrow:
1) A consolidated DPA ready for DocuSign that merges your redlines where possible and highlights escalations for legal review.
2) Subprocessor inventory CSV with last-attested dates (attached).
3) A short TIA scoping note that lists which regions would require additional safeguards (Switzerland, Norway) and proposed mitigations.
